data_type: SYNTHETIC development comparison, no hardware measurements
primary_preselection: 2 Hz / 5 deg, explicit motor profiles; no change to frequency/amplitude based on outcomes

comparison_contract.flags: Only original soft/hard limit and slew flags map to bits 0 and 1
comparison_contract.integral: Config k_integral maps directly; use zero for the primary comparison
comparison_contract.nonfinite_policy: Do not filter original inputs or outputs

profile.nominal_model_scope: Teaching/reference model, not a measured typical RoboMaster gimbal; same load for controlled motor comparison.
required_hardware_verification: allowable torque, current, speed and temperature
timestamps, measured loop timing and drive watchdog

actuator_dynamic_assumptions.note: Illustrative actuator lag; not the datasheet mechanical time constant.

profile.name: gm6020_current_v1_4

protocol.scope: Simulation assumes current mode is enabled. Hardware requires firmware >=1.0.11.2 and Assistant >=2.7 current-loop switch, verified explicitly.

motor.scope: Linear speed/torque approximation plus application limit; not a thermal model. Maximum continuous torque is not continuous stall torque.
